title: 49ers-Rams outcome tweaks the Super Bowl odds

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers-Rams outcome tweaks the Super Bowl odds
sources.description: 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy's 39-yard piss missile to receiver Demarcus Robinson in the first half of Thursday night's game in Australia became the first clear indication that San Francisco could indeed topple the 2026 edition of the Dream Team.
